body:
(Thank you for taking the time!)

The two indexes have the same data actually, they just happen to have different `searchable_attributes`. Not sure why it has been made this way because we can override that parameter on resquest.

And you will find records like this:

```json
{
  "favorite_foods": ["apples","oranges","bread"],
  "description": "I love to foo and also bar"
}
{
  "favorite_foods": ["aples","ORANGES!!"],
  "description": "Just foo for me"
}
```

And a user query = `?keywords=foo bar&foods=apples oranges`. So we were doing two requests, one to match the `keywords` on all fields, and the `foods` on `favorite_foods` only. (Made up example, in reality there are more fields involved, but at least one of the two queries MUST NOT search in all the searchable fields of the other query. Not sure about the other query).
